checkpoint.title: From Wild Zone 1's gate into the Research Lab

events.why: step 63: across to the Pokemon Research Lab's gate, into the rival's scene (Ryon on this save: "Allora, come va? Sei riuscita a catturare cinque specie di Pokemon?"), by the objective marker: out of the zone's gate the player faces whichever way it faced before (the timed legs from 2026-11-08 depended on that; console B, 2026-11-10). The scene takes the marker away at 10 to 13 to go and its dialog shows 9 to 11 s later (console B, 2026-11-14; 2026-11-16 18:47): a prompt or dialog counts after a distance read taken at 20 or less with the marker gone, or below 10 with it up. A prompt on the street with no read passed it 4 s in (17:34); junk single digits by a street dialog passed it at "6 to go" (18:47), and the real scene then played in lab_lobby.

step 63: Ryon at the lab gate; with five species registered he goes on, then the scene's black fade puts the player at the lab's steps (20 s, console B 2026-11-14 21:01). The walk ends on his dialog, so the scene has started.

step 65: Ryon's scene at the lab gate after 5/5, until control; at once when there is control already: plza/autostory's pass had control at once here too (1.2 s, console B 2026-11-14 21:01:47), research_lab_gate having played the whole scene. Here as mash_to_move_hints: the lean scene step waits 45 s for a scene to start, and nothing starts this part.

step 65: up the steps to the lab's "A Enter", by the objective marker. Its digits do not read on the steps (four looks, none, plza/autostory's pass on console B 2026-11-14), so the door's prompt counts with no read taken, but not after digits over 20 (from the street, 44 and 111, console B 2026-11-16 17:34).

steps 65-66: A Enter, the receptionist: third floor; autosave (A first: the door's prompt shows with the party bar up). The door's black fade comes 0.5 s after A (console B, 2026-11-14 21:01:52): control with no scene for 3 s is the player not at the door, not a pass.
the lobby's autosave was never seen in a run log (2026-11-14 21:02 passed lab_lobby with no badge logged): X, Save, B here, so 03.10 starts from a save at this spot.
